clue.text: Wood-shaper's short, thin piece of wood

indicators.note: short means the word is cut back by its final letter here

parts.note: a lathe is a machine that turns and shapes wood

explanation.surface: A woodworker's offcut is a slim little strip.
explanation.definitionFit: A lath is a narrow strip of timber, as used under plaster or in trellis.

clue.text: Not prepared to stay small

parts.note: to last is to stay or endure
minute means tiny

explanation.surface: Someone is unready to remain in a modest role.
explanation.definitionFit: A last-minute effort is left until it is almost too late, so unplanned.

clue.text: Ration of spirits poured over a pot, cooked just right

indicators.note: over in a down clue sets the first part above the second
poured means these letters are tipped out and rearranged

parts.note: a tot is a small measure of spirits, like the sailors' rum ration
an urn is a large pot or vessel

explanation.surface: A tot of rum is poured over a pot of food done perfectly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pot' looks like the cooking vessel the food is in, but it supplies an urn; 'over' works because in a down answer the shuffled tot sits on top.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom 'done to a turn' means cooked exactly enough, as on a roasting spit.

clue.text: One raises the roof with broad smile at athletics competition

parts.note: the hammer throw is a field event in athletics
to beam is to grin widely; a beam is a broad smile

explanation.surface: Someone grinning widely at a sports meeting brings the house down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Raises the roof' looks like wild cheering, but a hammerbeam literally holds a roof up in a timber building.
explanation.definitionFit: A hammerbeam is a short horizontal timber bracket supporting the rafters of a church or hall roof.

clue.text: Just imagine playing this song on a Spanish instrument

indicators.note: on in a down clue places the first part above the second

parts.note: an air is a tune or song
the guitar is the traditional Spanish instrument

explanation.surface: Picture performing a song on a flamenco guitar.
explanation.definitionFit: Air guitar is miming a guitar performance with no instrument at all.

clue.text: Requisite for garden often kept in litres

indicators.note: kept in means one piece is held inside the other

parts.note: much means a lot or often, as in 'does he go out much?'

explanation.surface: A gardening essential is often stored by the litre.
explanation.definitionFit: Mulch is a covering of compost or bark spread on garden beds.

clue.text: Looking back, notices report is out

indicators.note: is out means the letters are out of order and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: Reflecting on the past, someone sees a report has been published.
explanation.definitionFit: Retrospection is the act of reviewing past events.

clue.text: Each service in French is solemn

parts.note: RN, the Royal Navy, is one of the armed services
est is French for is

explanation.surface: Every church service in France is grave.
explanation.definitionFit: Earnest means serious and sincere in manner.

clue.text: Think this over: are you getting warm?

definitions.meaning: wine is ... by heating it with spices

explanation.definitionFit: Mull means ponder, and also heat wine or ale with spices.

clue.text: He noisily leaves the room for prison

definitions.meaning: someone who bangs the door on the way out is a door-...

explanation.definitionFit: Slammer is slang for a jail, and literally names one who slams doors.

clue.text: Provisioning vessel not to capsize, she prophesied

parts.note: a mother ship supplies smaller vessels

indicators.note: to capsize is to turn over, so the little word is turned back to front

explanation.surface: A supply ship that will not sink was foretold by a woman.
explanation.walkthrough: Mother Shipton was a legendary Yorkshire soothsayer of the Tudor era.
explanation.definitionFit: Mother Shipton is the semi-legendary English prophetess said to have foretold disasters.

clue.text: Misprint in a line added to American volume

indicators.note: added to means the following pieces are tacked on after the first

parts.note: liter is the American spelling of the metric unit of volume

explanation.surface: A typo crops up in one line of a US book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Volume' suggests a book, but it is a measure of capacity in its American spelling.
explanation.definitionFit: In printing, a literal is a misprint of a single letter.

clue.text: Speed up further on horse going to national memorial

indicators.note: on in an across clue puts the following pieces after the horse

parts.note: a mount is a horse one rides
to rush is to hurry up
more means further or additional

explanation.surface: A rider spurs the horse on towards a monument.
explanation.definitionFit: The carved presidential heads in South Dakota form a US national memorial.

clue.text: Experts handled with no end of care, as laid down in submission

parts.note: pros are professionals, experts

indicators.note: with no means a letter is taken away

parts.note: treated means handled or dealt with

indicators.note: end of picks the final letter of care

explanation.surface: Professionals carelessly dealt with something meant to be humbly accepted.
explanation.definitionFit: Prostrated means lying face down, as in submission or worship.

clue.text: Catholic, say, never repeated such a word

definitions.meaning: a Catholic is, for example, not of the Church of England: non-C of E
a word coined for one occasion only is a ... word

explanation.walkthrough: CE is the Church of England, so anyone outside it, a Roman Catholic for instance, is NON-CE.
explanation.definitionFit: Nonce describes something used just once, as in a word coined for a single occasion.

clue.text: Elephant, perhaps, one of a band

definitions.meaning: an elephant trumpets with its trunk, so it is one that trumpets
a brass band player of the trumpet

explanation.definitionFit: A trumpeter is any creature that trumpets, or a musician playing the trumpet.

clue.text: Hunters do err, having missed target

indicators.note: err means to go wrong, so the letters stray into a new order

explanation.surface: Hunters make mistakes and fail to hit their quarry.
explanation.definitionFit: An undershot volley falls short of what was aimed at.

clue.text: Time to wake up, given danger signal —— not showing a leg?

parts.note: to rouse is to wake someone
red is the colour that warns of danger

explanation.surface: Someone is roused by an alarm and told to get out of bed promptly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Show a leg' is a naval call to get up, which fits the waking surface; the definition instead means legs covered by trousers.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone wearing trousers has legs hidden from view, a playful sense of being clothed.

clue.text: Result of striking advance

parts.note: workers on strike are out
to come is to advance or approach

explanation.surface: The effect of a strike moves forward.
explanation.definitionFit: An outcome is the consequence or end result of something.

clue.text: Head of agriculture announced in orderly sequence

indicators.note: announced means the word is said aloud and the spelling changes

parts.note: a series is a set of things in order

explanation.surface: A farming chief speaks about things in their proper order.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Head of agriculture' looks like taking the letter A, but it means the Roman goddess presiding over farming.
explanation.definitionFit: Ceres was the Roman goddess of grain and farming, so the divine chief of agriculture.

clue.text: About to become adult, lacking wife, make new arrangements

parts.note: re means about or concerning

indicators.note: lacking means a letter is missing

parts.note: to grow up is to become adult

explanation.surface: Someone about to come of age, with no spouse, rethinks their plans.
explanation.definitionFit: To regroup is to reorganise or reassemble in a new formation.

clue.text: Set off to get a measure of whisky: is one itchy?

parts.note: to trigger something is to set it off
a finger is a measure of spirit poured to the depth of a finger

explanation.surface: Someone sets off to buy a dram and wonders if they are restless.
explanation.walkthrough: An itchy trigger finger belongs to someone eager to shoot.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom 'itchy trigger finger' describes the digit that is eager to fire a gun.

clue.text: Haul up in front of a policeman

indicators.note: in front of places that piece first
up in a down clue means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: to drag is to haul

explanation.surface: Someone is hauled up before an officer.
explanation.walkthrough: A garda is a police officer of the Irish Republic, from the Garda Síochána.
explanation.definitionFit: Garda is the Irish word for a member of the Irish police force.

clue.text: Loop of drapery is hot property

definitions.meaning: a curtain gathered into a hanging curve

explanation.definitionFit: Swag means a festoon of fabric and, as slang, a thief's loot.

clue.text: Man-about-town goes courting, yet eligible bachelor at the end

parts.note: to woo is to court, so he woos

indicators.note: at the end picks the final letter of each of the three words before it

explanation.surface: A socialite dates around, though a desirable single man comes out on top.
explanation.walkthrough: Bertie Wooster is P G Wodehouse's idle young gentleman, a classic man-about-town and perpetual bachelor.
explanation.definitionFit: Bertie Wooster, Wodehouse's comic hero, is the archetypal idle London socialite.

clue.text: Frequent place of Chinese disease

parts.note: the Han are the majority ethnic group of China
gout is a painful joint disease

explanation.surface: A spot where some Chinese illness keeps cropping up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Frequent' looks like an adjective, but it is a verb: a place you frequent.
explanation.definitionFit: A hangout is a spot someone visits regularly, a haunt.

clue.text: Trap energy for recycling their policy?

definitions.text: Trap energy for recycling their policy?

indicators.note: recycling means the letters are broken down and remade into something new

explanation.surface: An environmental party pledges to capture power and reuse it.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition: recycling is an environmental party's policy.
explanation.definitionFit: Ecological political parties campaign for recycling and conserving energy.

clue.text: Small dessert —— this eaten earlier?

parts.note: pud is British slang for pudding, a dessert

explanation.surface: A diner gets a little pudding and asks what came before it.
explanation.walkthrough: A potato is eaten in the main course, before the pudding.
explanation.definitionFit: A potato, informally a spud, is eaten with the main course before dessert.
